a_features: segarecomp_xplat_models.a_features (210 columns: 59 token-value counts, chain max/mean/long, targets out/in, zero/ASCII fraction, entropy, relocation fields, seed flag, PROVEN-reach count; then the +/-1 and +/-4 neighbour means)
condition_rule: models A/B/C train on C2 unless the T004 overall class is TRANSFER_HARMS (then C0); same genesis_lolo and xplat_lolo folds as T004; no hyper-parameter search (fixed configurations below) - nothing is tuned on the folds compared
enforcement: fit refuses unless this addendum's digests equal the current files and the plan; each fit record carries the addendum digest; no A/B/C fit was run before this addendum was committed

gates.B: built only if decide.select over {M1_HGB, A, M3_R, M4_DENSE@128, M4_DENSE@64} returns a configuration with genesis mean ER >= 0.10 (decide.b_gate) AND T004 is not EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: a bounded local instruction-aware Transformer: per-word input = embed(hi byte) + embed(lo byte) + the M3/M4 decode-token embeddings, d_model 64, 2 encoder layers, 4 heads, feed-forward 128, learned positions, attention restricted to non-overlapping 256-word windows with 64 words of real context (or PAD) on each side; per-word logit -> cell max (M4 aggregation); training exactly M4's budget and recipe (4000 steps, batch 8, AdamW lr 0.002 x0.1 after 80%, weight decay 1e-4, masked BCE with M4's pos_weight, lineage-uniform sampling, seeds 1-3 averaged)
gates.C: built only if B is better than A by the ordering with genesis mean ER lower by >= tau: B plus 2 rounds of typed sparse message passing per encoder layer over edges within the window+context: fall-through (ordinary decode -> next position by decoder length), direct branch / call target (computed as for A), overlapping interpretation (positions inside a decoded instruction's extent), each typed separately as CANDIDATE edges, plus a node flag for positions statically reachable from seed roots by fall-through and direct edges (PROVEN); hypothetical edges never mark a position reachable; same training budget as B
